preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == 2 * n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The binary string s must have a length of 2n and consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (m >= 0 and m <= 2 * n and len(p) == n)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output must include m distinct indices and n distinct indices for the subsequences.

postconditions.expression: any(s[p[i] - 1] == s[q[i] - 1] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The characters at the indices of the subsequences must be equal after the operation.

postconditions.expression: all(b[i] < b[i + 1] for i in range(m - 1)) and all(p[i] < p[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The indices in b and p must be in increasing order.
